HOLLOWMOOR

The bells stopped when the parish sank. Something wants them rung again.
Hollowmoor is played with a keyboard and mouse. Open this page on a computer to keep the vigil.
Every model, texture and sound in Hollowmoor is generated in code at load time. Rendered with three.js (MIT). Best with headphones, keyboard & mouse.

Difficulty

How to Survive

Ring 5 of the 7 Mourning Bells to unseal the Lychgates, open a gate, and walk out of Hollowmoor. Everyone who's knocked down is bound to a Weeping Post and starts sinking into the peat. A third binding means the moor keeps them.

The Reliquary

The killer is a saint's statue that cannot move while anyone looks at it. If it is on your screen with nothing in the way, it is stone. If nobody is watching, it is faster than you, and the only warning is the grinding of stone.

Looking at it drains your Resolve (the eye at the bottom of your screen). When your Resolve runs out, you Blink, and it moves while your eyes are shut. If you stare at it for too long, it starts to Lament: it weeps dust and your eyes give out far faster. The longer it is held still, the harder it lunges the moment nobody is looking. Take turns watching it with your teammates. Look away to recover your Resolve. Blink on purpose when it's out of sight.

Over time it plants Sentinels, hollow copies of itself, and it can jump into any copy that nobody is watching. Only the real one has a relic that smoulders in its chest. Throw a shroud over a Sentinel to seal it. If you're brave enough to shroud the real thing, you blind it for a few seconds.

It grows

As bells ring and survivors fall, the Reliquary ascends. As a Martyr its halo reforms and its cracks glow. Hold its gaze for more than a few seconds and its halo starts to burn. If anyone is still looking when it finishes, it rings the Toll of Stone, forcing everyone nearby to blink, and then it lunges. When you hear the choir rising, look away. As a Saint Unbound it grows wings, moves faster, and Laments sooner.

A survivor who has already been bound twice is not carried to a post. The Reliquary canonizes them, turning them to stone where they lie, and it can later step out of their statue. Watching it stops the stone from spreading, and reviving them in time saves them.

Relics and omens

Search the reliquary chests for one item. The Hand Mirror lets you watch what's behind you while you walk away. A Votive Candle casts a light that stops it from Lamenting or tolling nearby. Holy Water shatters a Sentinel or scalds the Reliquary. Linen Bandages heal you in seconds.

Crows scatter when you run past them, and the Reliquary hears them. They scatter when the stone moves near them, too. Stone cracks mark the ground where it has walked. Lightning shows you its outline wherever it stands. If it moved while your eyes were shut, a pale afterimage shows where it stood before.

Controls

W A S D move   Mouse lookShift sprint   C / Ctrl crouch
E or Left Mouse (hold): ring bell, heal, unbind, open gate, shroudSpace vault, drop pallet, toll checks
R (hold): mend your own woundsB blink on purpose (restores Resolve)
A/D alternate: wiggle free when carriedSpace on a post: try to tear free (first binding)
F or Right Mouse: use your item (hold for the mirror)Walking backward keeps your eyes on it, but it's slow
Esc pauseSpace skip the opening
